items.subject: Spirit hearse chariot: a compact swept vermilion and black lacquer shrine cart on two large spoked bronze and iron wheels, an upturned temple-roof canopy over a caged glowing teal soul-lantern, three curved iron scythe blades on a crossbar at the front sweeping low over the ground, a hooded faceless robed charioteer figure at the front holding a tall hooked iron staff with a hanging paper lantern

Shrine spirit barrier gate: two short vermilion lacquer posts on black lacquer stone footings, a burnished bronze lower rail and a vermilion top rail with five small iron and gold spear-tip finials, a glowing pale jade ward panel stretched between the posts at chest height, coral silk streamers hanging from the posts, wide and low, straight-on front facing the viewer

Low shrine slide-under arch: two slender vermilion lacquer posts on black lacquer bases with gold caps, a single horizontal vermilion beam with a thin black lacquer top rail crossing between them at chest height, a small hanging silk tag and a jade bead at the centre of the beam, a small pleated paper lantern hanging on the outside of each post, open empty space below the beam, wide, straight-on front facing the viewer

Low vermilion lacquer banquet table with gold rim and four square legs, set with a glazed roast on a platter, a celadon jade jar, an ivory porcelain rice bowl and three small ivory porcelain dumpling bowls, a small candle flame

Colossal carved jade and gold sky-serpent dragon head on a tall S-curved scaled neck rising vertically, emerald and celadon overlapping scales, branched gold antler horns, flowing whiskers, ivory fangs in a half-open jaw, blazing amber eyes, a glowing pearl held between the jaws, the head at the top of the neck looking forward

Grand palace gateway arch spanning a wide road: two pairs of tall cinnabar-red lacquer columns on carved granite plinths, gold column collars, a tiered upswept black-tiled temple roof with gold ridge ornaments on top, a deep indigo lacquer lintel board, coral silk banners, hanging paper lanterns, one very wide and tall completely open central passage between the inner columns with nothing inside it, wide straight-on front view

Floating sky island: an inverted cone of layered stratified ochre and slate rock hanging beneath a flat grassy top wreathed in soft white cloud, on top a tall five-tier vermilion lacquer pagoda with black roofs and gold finial, a small vermilion shrine gate and a gnarled bonsai pine

Floating sky island: an inverted cone of layered warm red sandstone rock hanging beneath a flat grassy top wreathed in soft white cloud, on top a slender vermilion lacquer lantern tower with glowing paper lanterns, a pink blossom tree and a small stone shrine

Monument of a coiled jade serpent tail spiralling upward around itself on a round carved granite pedestal, emerald scales, gold fins along the coil, the thin tail tip topped with a gold finial and a glowing amber orb

Tall carved granite temple lantern on a round stepped base, a vermilion lacquer column, a glowing pleated paper lantern box with gold corner posts, a small upswept black lacquer roof with a gold finial

Very tall shrine torii gate: two tall round vermilion lacquer pillars on black lacquer base sleeves, a straight vermilion tie beam near the top, a black-capped gently curved vermilion top lintel with upswept ends, a small black centre tablet, a glowing pleated paper lantern hanging from a short bracket on the outside of each pillar, wide open space between the pillars, straight-on front view

Small round floating meadow planet sphere: green grass all over the sphere, a curved white-domed sanctuary cottage with a vermilion upswept roof on top, a gnarled bonsai pine and a pink blossom tree, a ring of stepping stones, a collar of soft white cloud underneath

Spirit hearse chariot body only, with NO wheels at all: a compact swept vermilion and black lacquer shrine cart box with empty bare axle stubs on each side where wheels would mount, an upturned temple-roof canopy over a caged glowing teal soul-lantern, three curved iron scythe blades on a crossbar at the front sweeping low, a hooded faceless robed charioteer figure at the front holding a tall hooked iron staff.
